H-CSCA-01.mechanism: Counterfactual coalition credit separates a delayed manipulable cause from temporal, correlated and stochastic non-causes.

S01-C01.text: Counterfactual Shapley values are defined from counterfactual natural total effects and satisfy the paper's causal credit desiderata.

S01-C02.text: The paper proves policy-gradient / optimal-policy equivalence for its phi-MDP reward redistribution.

S01-C03.text: The paper proposes a consistent linear-time coalition-sampling estimator and Prioritized Trajectory Replay.
